archetype: Organic Precision Commercial (Swiss Precision meets Warm Emerald & Amber Warmth)
app_type: Hybrid Fullstack Business SaaS Platform (Mobile-First, Bilingual RTL/LTR, Light/Dark/System)

typography.letter_spacing: 0px (CRITICAL: Do not apply letter-spacing to Arabic text as it breaks cursive script joining)

forbidden_styles: FORBIDDEN: Standard generic Inter or Arial for main headings
FORBIDDEN: Pure pitch black #000000 backgrounds (use tinted deep charcoal/navy slate #090D16)
FORBIDDEN: Letter-spacing on Arabic headings/body (breaks script joining)
FORBIDDEN: Centered body text in paragraphs or data cards
FORBIDDEN: Full transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or mobile bottom nav (must use backdrop-blur + semi-opaque bg)
FORBIDDEN: Raw native browser date/select inputs (use Shadcn custom primitives adjusted for RTL/LTR)

mobile.quick_actions_bar: Horizontally scrollable pill buttons with icons for rapid creation (+ Invoice, + Quote, + Customer, + Payment)

desktop.sidebar: Collapsible dynamic sidebar with full RTL support (mirrored icons and end-aligned chevron indicators)
desktop.header: Sticky glassmorphic top app header with search bar, notification center, currency indicator, theme toggle, and language selector

dashboard.welcome_hero: Warm, personalized hero card with quick metrics summary, active currency indicator, and greeting
dashboard.kpi_cards: Bento grid structure with trend indicators (+%), sparkline visual, and direct links to filtered views
dashboard.recent_activity_feed: Dense timeline stream with status dots and humanized timestamp labels

invoices_and_quotes.print_mode: Dedicated printable view styled specifically with `@media print` rules: hides sidebars/navs, uses clean black/white high-density table format with business header & QR code stamp

ai_assistant.name: WASSILHA Smart Business AI
ai_assistant.style: Expandable bottom-right composer drawer / modal with pre-built prompt chips ('Summarize pending payments', 'Generate sales report for this month', 'Draft overdue payment message')

interactive_map.theme: Custom tile layer matching active theme (dark/light) with custom marker icons for customers and store locations

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on ALL buttons, inputs, tabs, metrics, and modals

instructions_to_main_agent: Maintain complete bilingual state sync between English and Arabic. When switching language, automatically set document direction to 'rtl' for Arabic and 'ltr' for English.
Use logical CSS utility classes or responsive direction helpers (e.g., flex-row-reverse where appropriate or logical padding/margin) to ensure seamless layout mirror in RTL.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for all user actions (Invoice created, Payment recorded, Customer added, Settings saved).
Ensure standard fallback state images and empty states (with illustrations and quick create action buttons) when no data exists.
Keep touch target heights at least 44px on mobile components.
